verdict.rationale: Paxos docs confirm monthly reserve composition and attestation reports for USDG (paxos-docs-43) and 1:1 USD redeemability (paxos-docs-42), covering the reserve/attestation part of the story. However there is no evidence of any yield or rewards program, its eligibility criteria, or regulatory caveats being documented. Missing for 10: yield/rewards program details, eligibility rules, regulatory caveats/disclosures.
